evals.prompt: Extract frames from a 2-second synthetic test video at 30fps and confirm the output.
evals.expected_output: 60 PNG frames in the output directory, named frame-0001.png through frame-0060.png

assertions.name: frame-count-matches-duration-times-fps
assertions.description: A 2-second clip at 30fps must produce exactly 60 frames — not approximately, exactly. This is the one claim in the whole pipeline that is fully mechanical and has no excuse to be wrong.

assertions.name: frames-are-sequentially-named-and-loadable
assertions.description: Output files follow frame-%04d.png and are each a valid, non-zero-byte PNG a canvas /Image() can load.

evals.prompt: Run extract_frames.sh against a nonexistent input file.
evals.expected_output: A clear error on stderr and a non-zero exit code — never a silent empty output directory.

assertions.name: missing-input-fails-loudly
assertions.description: Same standard as the rest of Company OS: a script that can't do its job refuses, it doesn't pretend to succeed.
